lessons.description: First draft had quote_line_rate 0.371 vs source 0.258 — too much direct dialogue. apocalypse_heroine genre is more internal monologue/narration driven than it seems.
lessons.fix: Full rewrite with emphasis on short narrative fragments over dialogue exchanges.

lessons.description: First draft question_marks_per_k was 7.33 (over threshold). Too many rhetorical questions in internal monologue.
lessons.fix: Replace rhetorical questions with declarative emotional statements. Use questions only at key plot moments.

lessons.description: Rhythm-passing draft was only 8800 chars. Required 50+ individual line additions to reach 10000. Each addition had to be ≤12 chars to not break avg_line_chars ceiling.
lessons.fix: When source avg_line_chars is ~17 and candidate needs to stay ≤21.7, expansion must be done via short standalone fragments (3-10 chars per line). Budget: ~8 lines needed per 100 chars added.

lessons.description: Source avg=17.35 → ceiling ~21.69 (source*1.25). Any expansion line longer than ~19 chars pushes avg up. Need to track this carefully during expansion.
lessons.fix: Track avg after every batch of edits. When avg approaches 21, only add lines under 15 chars.

apocalypse_heroine.key_traits: Internal monologue heavy, declarative fragments, minimal dialogue, strong short-line density
apocalypse_heroine.pitfalls: Easy to over-dialogue (the genre feels dialogue-heavy because of short lines, but actual quote rate is low)
apocalypse_heroine.expansion_strategy: Add physical detail fragments, environmental observations, emotional single-clause lines
